questions.q:
Given below are two statements :
Statement I : $\lim _{x \rightarrow 0}\left(\frac{\tan ^{-1} x+\log _e \sqrt{\frac{1+x}{1-x}}-2 x}{x^5}\right)=\frac{2}{5}$
Statement II : $\lim _{\mathrm{x} \rightarrow 1}\left(\mathrm{x}^{\frac{2}{1-\mathrm{x}}}\right)=\frac{1}{\mathrm{e}^2}$
In the light of the above statements, choose the correct answer from the options given below :
options: Statement I is false but Statement II is true
Statement I is true but Statement II is false
Both Statement I and Statement II are false
Both Statement I and Statement II are true
questions.subject: Mathematics
questions.solution:
$\begin{aligned}
& \lim _{x \rightarrow 0} \frac{\tan ^{-1} x+\frac{1}{2}[\ln (1+x)-\ln (1-x)]-2 x}{x^5} \\ & =\lim _{x \rightarrow 0} \frac{\left(x-\frac{x^3}{3}+\frac{x^5}{5} \ldots\right)+\frac{1}{2}\left[x-\frac{x^2}{2}+\frac{x^3}{3} \ldots-\left(-x-\frac{x^2}{2}-\frac{x^3}{3} \ldots\right)\right]-2 x}{x^5} \\ & =\lim _{x \rightarrow 0} \frac{2 x+\frac{2 x^5}{5} \ldots-2 x}{x^5}=\frac{2}{5} \\ & \lim _{x \rightarrow 1} x^{\frac{2}{(1-x)}}=e^{\lim _{x \rightarrow l}\left(\frac{2}{(1-x)}\right)(x-1)}=e^{-2}
\end{aligned}$
\Rightarrow Both statements correct

On adding all the above inequalities, we get

r+2r+…+nr≤r+2r+...+nr<r+2r+...nr+n
